class: Embedded reCAPTCHA on single-page form caused premature agent abort, and work authorization without sponsorship was falsely flagged as legal conflict
symptom: Tri-City Group (BambooHR): form filling halted prematurely at step 10 because a reCAPTCHA iframe at the bottom of the single-page application caused PageAgent to immediately abort with captcha before questions were answered. In addition, questions asking for authorization 'without visa or sponsorship' were incorrectly matched by _AUTHORIZED_Q causing false legal conflicts and forcing 'Yes' when candidate requires visa sponsorship.
root_cause: PageAgent._run_locked returned Outcome('captcha') immediately upon detecting any CAPTCHA on the page even when an unfilled application form with >3 input fields was present. Furthermore, safety._AUTHORIZED_Q matched 'authorized to work without sponsorship', where answering 'No' (for candidates needing visa sponsorship) was flagged by safety.legal_answer_conflicts as a conflict with profile.legally_eligible_to_work ('Yes'), and page_agent.py correct_from_profile did not handle without_sponsorship qualifications or verify legal age 18.
why_tests_missed: Tests tested CAPTCHA detection and legal authorization separately, but did not test single-page embedded forms where CAPTCHA is co-located with active form fields, nor the compound 'without sponsorship' question nuance.
fix: Allowed up to 3 passes on embedded forms with active inputs before halting for CAPTCHA at the review/submit gate; added without_sponsorship qualification in safety.legal_answer_conflicts and page_agent.py correct_from_profile; added _AGE_18_Q verification; updated apply_flow._resume_with_current_email to use company-tailored document naming.
prevention: Never halt prematurely on a multi-field form due to passive CAPTCHA badges before filling candidate questions, and distinguish general work authorization from authorization without sponsorship.
